title: Pharmacology-based molecular docking of 4-methylcatechol and its role in RANKL-mediated ROS/Keap1/Nrf2 signalling axis and osteoclastogenesis.
authors: Xu, Yang; Song, Dezhi; Su, Yuangang; Chen, Junchun; Wu, Liwei; Lian, Haoyu; Hai, Na; Li, Jing; Jiang, Jie; Zhao, Jinmin; Xu, Jiake; Liu, Qian
one_liner_zh: 该文研究4-甲基儿茶酚通过Keap1/Nrf2信号轴抑制破骨细胞分化，分子对接仅涉及小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: 4-Methylcatechol (4-MC) is an agonist of various neurotrophic factors, which can upregulate the expression of Heme oxygenase 1 (HO-1) protein by activating nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2), thereby inhibiting oxidative stress-induced neural stem cell death. During RANKL-stimulated osteoclast differentiation, intracellular reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels were increased. Nonetheless, the effect of 4-MC on osteoclast formation and bone resorption function has not been researched. In this study, we investigated the effect of HO-1 upregulation by 4-MC on RANKL-induced osteoclastogenesis and explored the molecular mechanism of HO-1 upregulation by 4-MC. We found that the small molecule compound 4-MC could bind to Keap1 amino acid residue of glycine GLY 367, isoleucine ILE 559 and valine VAL 606, with a predicted binding energy of -4.99 kcal/mol. 4-MC was found to inhibit osteoclast differentiation in vitro by activating Nrf2 to scavenge ROS, inhibiting NF-kappaB phosphorylation, and alleviating osteoporosis in ovariectomized (OVX) mice. Taken together, 4-MC reduces ROS by inhibiting Keap1, thereby preventing OVX-induced bone loss.
abstract_zh: 4-甲基儿茶酚（4-MC）是多种神经营养因子的激动剂，通过激活核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）上调血红素加氧酶1（HO-1）蛋白的表达，从而抑制氧化应激诱导的神经干细胞死亡。在RANKL刺激的破骨细胞分化过程中，细胞内活性氧（ROS）水平升高。然而，4-MC对破骨细胞形成和骨吸收功能的影响尚未被研究。在本研究中，我们探讨了4-MC上调HO-1对RANKL诱导的破骨细胞生成的作用，并探索了4-MC上调HO-1的分子机制。我们发现，小分子化合物4-MC能够与Keap1氨基酸残基甘氨酸GLY 367、异亮氨酸ILE 559和缬氨酸VAL 606结合，预测结合能为-4.99 kcal/mol。研究发现，4-MC通过激活Nrf2清除ROS，抑制NF-kappaB磷酸化，从而在体外抑制破骨细胞分化，并缓解去卵巢（OVX）小鼠的骨质疏松。综上所述，4-MC通过抑制Keap1减少ROS，从而预防OVX诱导的骨丢失。
